title: Boolean block expectation functional
statement: For natural numbers $n,m$ and a real parameter $\rho$, define a continuous complex-linear functional on the continuous complex-valued functions on the paired torus. It is the sum over pairs of Boolean-cube points of the noise-kernel-weighted evaluations at the corresponding pair of normalized block vectors, multiplied by the uniform weight for a cube of dimension $nm$.
caveat: The snippet does not define the noise kernel, uniform weight, normalized block vectors, or Gaussian torus map, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be stated from this payload.
